title: A Snow Leopard Can Leap 50 Feet in One Jump

scenes.text: A snow leopard can jump 50 feet in one leap.
That's longer than a city bus.
It lives high in the mountains of Central Asia, where one slip means a long fall.
Its back legs are powerful, and its thick tail works like a balance pole.
So it can leap across cliffs and gullies that other hunters simply avoid.

description:
Snow leopards can leap as far as 50 feet, longer than a city bus, across steep mountain terrain.
Powerful back legs and a long tail for balance help them pounce on prey on rocky slopes.
Could you clear 50 feet?
first_comment: Bonus: its tail is thick and nearly as long as its body, which helps balance on cliffs. Which big cat is your favorite?
